question: Where can I get the available grid connection capacity per substation or node in France, for generation and for demand, with the latest value and its history?

answer.summary: Caparéseau (RTE with Enedis and local distributors) publishes generation hosting capacity per substation: 3,116 mainland substations in a national CSV without login, with per-substation update dates up to 2026-11-10. It covers production only and is indicative; no per-node consumption capacity was found (RTE Cartostock covers batteries, viewer only). There is no history file: annual 31 December tables sit in RTE's regional reports. Corsica and overseas are on EDF's portal (101 rows, quarterly).
main_caveats: Caparéseau shows capacity reserved under the S3REnR schemes, not physical grid headroom, and is indicative and non-binding.
INFO_NA, RTE_CDR and GRD1_CDR differ: a zero can be saturated or not reserved; installed transformer power is not available capacity.
No demand-side capacity per node was found; Caparéseau and the Enedis zone map are production-only.
History exists only as annual PDF tables in RTE reports (rounded to integers in 2024) and needs manual extraction.
Mainland Caparéseau excludes Corsica and overseas; data.gouv.fr links to the EDF dataset are dead redirects.
answer.confidence_reason: National CSV, regional JSON and two RTE reports were downloaded and compared; consumption-side tools (Cartostock data, Enedis collectivités map) and other regions' reports were not read.

attributes.note: Caparéseau lists 3,116 mainland substations by code and name; EDF SEI lists Corsica and overseas; coordinates are valid for 3,076 of 3,116.
INFO_NA, RTE_CDR and GRD1_CDR give S3REnR capacity left per substation; unit MW is stated by RTE/EDF files, not by Caparéseau labels; values are indicative.
Caparéseau and the Enedis zone map are production-only; no per-substation capacity for consumption sites was found.
attributes.gap_note: Cartostock (batteries) is viewer-only and the Enedis collectivités capacity tool sits behind an account; neither was read; RTE API catalogue needs an account.

attributes.note: Caparéseau snapshot of 2026-11-10 with a per-substation update date (2026-02-04 to 2026-11-10); EDF SEI rows dated 2026-10-01.
Caparéseau and EDF keep only the current state; RTE annual reports give 31 December tables (Hauts-de-France 2024 and 2025 opened).
attributes.gap_note: Open the other regional reports and the 2020-2023 editions to measure the span; Caparéseau has no history.

attributes.note: EDF SEI states quarterly and RTE reports are annual; Caparéseau only says 'régulièrement' and shows 32 distinct per-substation dates.
attributes.gap_note: No stated schedule for Caparéseau; dates observed are irregular.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL "https://www.capareseau.fr/medias/27F7C201-1CD6-C0F6-8293-A6E5539F6A1E" -o capareseau_france.csv   # skip row 2 (column labels); region JSON: /medias/<posts_key> read from /region/<code>
how_to_use.example_result: 3,116 rows. Row: Code 936AA, Nom INDRE SUD, S3REnR CENTRE-VAL DE LOIRE, INFO_CR 57, INFO_NA 18.9, INFO_FAS3R 38.1, INFO_ESS3R 0, RTE_CDR 0, GRD1_CDR 0, TXA 0%, INFO_QP 70.49.
steps: Download the national CSV linked as 'Télécharger les données sur la France entière' on any region page (no login; content-disposition backup_20261110_113147.csv).
Read with ';' separator; row 2 holds the French column labels, data start on row 3.
Use INFO_NA, RTE_CDR and GRD1_CDR for available generation capacity; INFO_FAS3R for queue power; INFO_ESS3R for connected power.
Get the per-substation update date from the region JSON (field 'updated', dd/mm/yyyy); the CSV has none.
Store the snapshot with its date yourself: the site keeps no history.
reading_traps: Capacity is S3REnR reserved capacity left, not the physical headroom of the grid.
INFO_NA, RTE_CDR and GRD1_CDR measure different things; a 0 can mean saturated, not reserved or not applicable.
GRD1_PTRE is installed transformer power, not available capacity.
580 of 3,116 substations have no distribution operator tagged in the JSON; 10 have empty values; 40 coordinate pairs fall outside Lambert-93 France.
Mainland only: Corsica and overseas are not in this file.
Values are indicative and non-binding for the operators.

problems: No documented API: the CSV and JSON links are generated by the pages.
Download id (/medias/27F7C201-…) is read from the page; its stability was not tested.
Legal notice states values are indicative and gives no open licence.
